Turn ambition into a roadmap, and the roadmap into results.

problem.title: La inteligencia de negocio sigue siendo inaccesible, genérica e insegura.
problem.body: El mercado aún no ha convertido la IA y las herramientas digitales en una capa escalable para la ejecución táctica y estratégica del negocio.
points: La consultoría sigue siendo inaccesible para la mayoría de las empresas.
Los modelos de lenguaje grandes no son especialistas y no entienden el contexto de la empresa.
La mayoría de las soluciones de IA no son lo bastante seguras para el trabajo empresarial real.
problem.solve: Ese es exactamente el vacío que cierra Consultify.

pattern.title: Lo que Spotify hizo por la música: acceso, calidad y confianza a escala.
pattern.body: Spotify no creó más música. Hizo que la gran música fuera instantáneamente accesible, fiable y fácil de usar. Consultify aplica ese mismo cambio a la inteligencia de negocio.
examples: Acceso directo al conocimiento de negocio de Harvard.
Inteligencia que trabaja en el contexto completo de tu empresa, no en prompts aislados.
Confianza y seguridad mediante tecnología adaptada a los requisitos individuales de tu empresa.
pattern.summary: Acceso. Calidad. Confianza. Ese es el cambio.

cta.description: Assessments are only the beginning. Discover the full suite of AI-powered tools designed to turn maturity insights into operational results.

drd.description: Advanced tool for assessing digital maturity and creating development roadmaps.
drd.longDescription: Digital Readiness Diagnosis (DRD) is a proprietary DBR77 methodology designed to support companies in their digital transformation journey. It covers assessment of digital maturity, analysis of external factors, and creation of detailed development roadmaps.

siri.description: Global standard for evaluating Industry 4.0 maturity across 3 key pillars.
siri.longDescription: The Smart Industry Readiness Index (SIRI) is a global initiative created in partnership with the Singapore EDB and WEF. As the international standard for I4.0, it evaluates 16 dimensions across Process, Technology, and Organization to prioritize transformation efforts.

adma.description: European standard for "Factory of the Future" digital transformation audits.
adma.longDescription: ADMA was developed by the European Commission to assist companies in adopting advanced manufacturing technologies. It assesses a company's digital maturity across seven key areas, guiding them towards becoming a world-class Factory of the Future.

lean-4-0.name: Lean 4.0
lean-4-0.description: 3-Phase optimization path: Measure, Optimize, and Automate.
lean-4-0.longDescription: Lean 4.0 is a specialized DBR77 methodology that bridges classic Lean manufacturing with Industry 4.0 technology. It follows a rigorous 3-phase path: Measure (establishing data-driven baselines), Optimize (eliminating waste), and Automate (high-ROI technology injection).
